_comment: The 7-Zip that makes and opens Backups (docs/adr/0002-one-encrypted-backup-file.md): 7-Zip's public-domain 7zr.exe, pinned by version and SHA-256. Get-SevenZip in lib/Backup.ps1 downloads it on first use and refuses any file whose hash differs. To move to a newer 7-Zip, take the release asset's digest from https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases.
